title: BanglaUtilityBillSchema
description: Schema for extracting span-grounded key information from Bangla utility bills (electricity, gas, water: DESCO, DPDC, TITAS, NESCO, WASA).

biller_name.description: Name of utility agency (e.g., ডেসকো, ডিপিডিসি, তিতাস গ্যাস, নেসকো, ওয়াসা)

bill_month.description: Billing cycle month and year (e.g., জুলাই ২০২৪ / October 2024)

issue_date.description: Bill issue date (standardized YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY)

due_date.description: Last payment due date without surcharge

total_units_consumed.description: Total electricity/gas units consumed during billing period

current_charge.description: Current month charge in BDT before taxes and surcharges

total_payable_amount.description: Net payable amount within due date in BDT

payable_after_due_date.description: Net payable amount after due date including late surcharge
